sentences.text: Day 5 – Weekend Routine On weekends, I'm a bit of a homebody.
sentences.text_ko: 5일 차예요. 주말에는 집에 있는 걸 좋아하는 편이에요.

sentences.text: I like to sleep in and take things slow.
sentences.text_ko: 늦잠 자고 천천히 하루를 시작하는 게 좋아요.

sentences.text: I usually start my day off with a cup of coffee.
sentences.text_ko: 보통 하루는 커피 한 잔으로 시작해요.

sentences.text: It's a little treat that helps wake me up.
sentences.text_ko: 잠 깨는 데 딱 좋은 작은 즐거움이죠.

sentences.text: While drinking my coffee, I like to get organized for the week ahead.
sentences.text_ko: 커피 마시면서 한 주를 미리 정리해요.

sentences.text: I check my emails, respond to messages, and go over my schedule.
sentences.text_ko: 이메일 확인하고, 메시지 답하고, 일정도 훑어봐요.

sentences.text: I use my laptop and a few different apps to help me keep track of everything.
sentences.text_ko: 노트북이랑 몇 가지 앱으로 이것저것 관리해요.

sentences.text: Once I get my to -do list sorted out, I move on to meal prep.
sentences.text_ko: 할 일 목록 정리하고 나면 밀프렙을 시작해요.

sentences.text: Meal prep helps me eat healthier and saves me time during the week.
sentences.text_ko: 밀프렙 덕분에 더 건강하게 먹고 평일에 시간도 아껴요.

sentences.text: I usually keep it simple by making a few easy dishes that I can quickly grab from the fridge.
sentences.text_ko: 냉장고에서 바로 꺼내 먹을 수 있는 간단한 메뉴 위주로 해요.

sentences.text: While cooking, I try to clean as I go.
sentences.text_ko: 요리하면서 틈틈이 정리도 같이 해요.

sentences.text: After meal prepping, I take a short break before doing some chores.
sentences.text_ko: 밀프렙 끝나면 집안일 하기 전에 잠깐 쉬어요.

sentences.text: My weekend chores usually include wiping down surfaces, vacuuming the floors, sorting the recycling, and taking out the trash.
sentences.text_ko: 주말 집안일은 보통 청소하고, 바닥 밀고, 분리수거하고, 쓰레기 버리는 거예요.

sentences.text: After cleaning and working up an appetite, it's finally time to relax.
sentences.text_ko: 청소하고 나면 배도 고파지고, 이제 좀 쉬고 싶어져요.

sentences.text: I'm not usually in the mood to cook after meal prepping all afternoon, so I like to order delivery for dinner.
sentences.text_ko: 하루 종일 밀프렙 했더니 저녁엔 요리할 기분이 안 나서 배달 시켜요.

sentences.text: My go -to delivery foods are noodles and dumplings.
sentences.text_ko: 보통 면 요리랑 만두를 시켜 먹어요.

sentences.text: I'm addicted to dumplings.
sentences.text_ko: 나 만두에 진심이거든요.

sentences.text: While eating, I like to watch Netflix and unwind a bit.
sentences.text_ko: 먹으면서 넷플릭스 보면서 좀 쉬어요.

sentences.text: It's the perfect way to wrap up the weekend and get ready for the week ahead.
sentences.text_ko: 이렇게 주말을 마무리하면 다음 주 준비가 딱 돼요.

sentences.text: On weekends, I'm a bit of a homebody.
sentences.text_ko: 주말에는 집에 있는 걸 좋아하는 편이에요.

full_transcript: Day 5 – Weekend Routine On weekends, I'm a bit of a homebody. I like to sleep in and take things slow. I usually start my day off with a cup of coffee. It's a little treat that helps wake me up. While drinking my coffee, I like to get organized for the week ahead. I check my emails, respond to messages, and go over my schedule. I use my laptop and a few different apps to help me keep track of everything. Once I get my to-do list sorted out, I move on to meal prep. Meal prep helps me eat healthier and saves me time during the week. I usually keep it simple by making a few easy dishes that I can quickly grab from the fridge. While cooking, I try to clean as I go. After meal prepping, I take a short break before doing some chores. My weekend chores usually include wiping down surfaces, vacuuming the floors, sorting the recycling, and taking out the trash. After cleaning and working up an appetite, it's finally time to relax. I'm not usually in the mood to cook after meal prepping all afternoon, so I like to order delivery for dinner. My go-to delivery foods are noodles and dumplings. I'm addicted to dumplings. While eating, I like to watch Netflix and unwind a bit. It's the perfect way to wrap up the weekend and get ready for the week ahead. On weekends, I'm a bit of a homebody.
